name: dealflow-weekly-digest
description: Write the weekly leadership digest: projects seen, key findings, stage changes and follow-ups to chase.

body.en: Read `busa-dealflow`, then follow this skill to write this week's digest as a draft and send me a five-line summary with the link.
body.zh-CN: 先读 `busa-dealflow`，再按本技能为本周写一份周报草稿，回复我五行摘要和链接。

body.en: Read `busa-dealflow`, then follow this skill for last Monday to Sunday. If a draft for that week exists, update it instead of adding another.
body.zh-CN: 先读 `busa-dealflow`，再按本技能为上周一到周日写周报；那一周已有草稿就更新它，不要再建一条。

label.en: Check a digest against its records
label.zh-CN: 核对一份周报和原始记录

body.en: For the digest I name, check every line against the meeting and follow-up records it cites and list anything that does not match. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 核对我说的那份周报：逐行对照它引用的会议和待跟进记录，列出对不上的地方。不要修改任何记录。
